Hero.Title: Microsoft consulting
Hero.Description: Optimize your productivity with the Microsoft ecosystem. We help you get the most out of Power Automate, SharePoint, Power BI and SPFx to automate your processes and improve collaboration.

Presentation.Intro: Companies using Microsoft 365 often leverage only a fraction of the possibilities offered by this platform. Between Power Automate for automation, SharePoint for document management, Power BI for data analysis and SPFx for application development, the Microsoft ecosystem offers powerful tools that remain underused. We support you to fully exploit these technologies and transform how you work.

Why.Title: Why optimize your Microsoft environment
Why.Text: If your company already uses Microsoft 365, you likely have a license that includes many tools whose potential you are not exploiting. Power Automate can automate hundreds of repetitive tasks, SharePoint can structure and secure all your business information, Power BI can transform your data into interactive dashboards, and SPFx allows you to create custom applications perfectly integrated. The return on investment is quick because you are using tools you already own.

PowerAutomate.Title: Automation with Power Automate
PowerAutomate.Text: Power Automate allows you to create automated workflows between your Microsoft applications and hundreds of third-party services. We design automations that eliminate manual and repetitive tasks such as data collection, sending notifications, creating reports or synchronizing between systems. Each workflow is documented and can be easily modified by your internal teams once set up.

SharePoint.Title: SharePoint solutions
SharePoint.Text: SharePoint is much more than just a file storage space. We create SharePoint sites that structure your information, automate your business processes and facilitate team collaboration. Whether managing projects, centralizing knowledge or creating modern intranets, we configure SharePoint according to your specific needs while respecting governance best practices.

PowerBI.Title: Power BI dashboards
PowerBI.Text: Power BI transforms your data into interactive visualizations that facilitate decision making. We connect your existing data sources, whether in Excel, SharePoint, your CRM or your management system, and create dashboards that automatically update your key indicators. These reports can be accessed from any device and shared securely with the right people.

SPFx.Title: SPFx development
SPFx.Text: The SharePoint Framework allows you to create modern web applications that integrate perfectly into your Microsoft 365 environment. We develop custom web parts, extensions and applications that extend the native functionalities of SharePoint. These solutions are designed to be maintainable, secure and scalable according to Microsoft standards.

Integration.Title: Integration and ecosystem
Integration.Text: The strength of the Microsoft ecosystem lies in the integration between its different tools. We design solutions that combine Power Automate, SharePoint, Power BI and Teams to create coherent work environments. For example, a Power Automate workflow can trigger actions in SharePoint, update data in Power BI and send notifications in Teams, all seamlessly for the user.

Training.Title: Training and support
Training.Text: We do not just implement solutions, we also train your teams so they can maintain and evolve them. Our training sessions are adapted to everyone's level and include clear documentation. The goal is to make your company autonomous while knowing that we remain available for more complex needs.

Azure.Title: Azure cloud infrastructure and services
Azure.Intro: Beyond Microsoft 365 productivity tools, Azure offers robust cloud infrastructure that extends your business capabilities. We help Geneva companies leverage Azure for scalability, security, and advanced integration.

Functions.Title: Azure Functions and serverless computing
Functions.Text: We develop serverless applications using Azure Functions that execute code in response to events without managing infrastructure. Perfect for processing data from SharePoint, responding to webhooks, integrating external APIs, or performing scheduled tasks. You only pay for actual execution time, making it cost-effective for intermittent workloads. Functions can be triggered by Power Automate, HTTP requests, timers, or Azure services.

LogicApps.Title: Azure Logic Apps for enterprise integration
LogicApps.Text: Logic Apps enable sophisticated workflow automation with hundreds of pre-built connectors for enterprise systems (SAP, Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server). We design integration flows that connect your on-premises systems with cloud services, transform data between formats, and orchestrate complex business processes. Unlike Power Automate, Logic Apps offer enterprise-grade features like virtual network integration, managed identities, and ISO certifications.

Storage.Title: Azure Storage and data management
Storage.Text: We configure secure Azure Storage solutions for your business data: blob storage for documents and media, file shares for legacy applications, table storage for structured data, and queue storage for message processing. Data can be encrypted at rest and in transit, with access controlled via Azure AD. We set up backup policies, lifecycle management, and replication to Swiss data centers for compliance.

SQL.Title: Azure SQL Database and data platforms
SQL.Text: We migrate and manage business databases on Azure SQL Database with automatic backups, point-in-time restore, and high availability. For analytics workloads, we deploy Azure Synapse or Data Lake solutions that scale to petabytes. Integration with Power BI provides real-time dashboards from your cloud data. All with Swiss data residency options for regulatory compliance.

Security.Title: Azure security and identity
Security.Text: We implement comprehensive security using Azure AD for identity management, Key Vault for secrets and encryption keys, and Security Center for threat detection. Conditional access policies enforce multi-factor authentication, device compliance, and location-based restrictions. We configure private endpoints to keep traffic within Azure's network backbone, and use Azure Policy to enforce governance standards across your subscriptions.

DevOps.Title: Azure DevOps and automation
DevOps.Text: We establish CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to automate deployment of your SPFx web parts, Power Automate flows, and custom applications. Code is versioned, tested automatically, and deployed through controlled stages (development, staging, production). This ensures reliability and allows quick rollback if issues occur. Teams collaborate efficiently with boards, repos, and test plans integrated in one platform.

IntegrationFlows.Title: Integration flows between Microsoft tools
IntegrationFlows.Intro: The real strength of the Microsoft ecosystem lies in the ability to connect different tools to create intelligent workflows. Here are some common integration patterns we deploy for our clients in Geneva:

SharePointPowerBI.Title: SharePoint → Power BI
SharePointPowerBI.Text: Your SharePoint lists and libraries feed Power BI dashboards in real time. Perfect for tracking project status, inventory management, or analyzing customer data without manual exports. Filters and interactive visuals allow everyone to quickly find the information they need.

PowerAutomateSPFx.Title: Power Automate → SPFx
PowerAutomateSPFx.Text: A Power Automate workflow can be triggered directly from a custom button in SharePoint (via SPFx). For example: click on a document to launch an approval process, send a notification to Teams, or archive files in specific folders based on metadata. Everything happens without leaving the page.

TeamsSharePoint.Title: Teams ↔ SharePoint
TeamsSharePoint.Text: Each Teams channel can be connected to a SharePoint document library. We add custom tabs to display forms, dashboards, or lists directly in Teams. This allows project collaboration without switching between applications: everything is centralized in one interface.

SPFxAzureFunctions.Title: SPFx → Azure Functions
SPFxAzureFunctions.Text: Your custom SharePoint components can call Azure Functions to integrate external systems (ERP, CRM, payment APIs, etc.). This allows you to enrich SharePoint forms with data from other sources or trigger complex calculations without overloading SharePoint. Security is ensured via authentication tokens.

PowerBIEmbedded.Title: Power BI Embedded
PowerBIEmbedded.Text: We integrate Power BI reports directly into SharePoint pages or custom applications (SPFx or external web apps). Users access contextualized analytics without leaving their working environment. Permissions are synchronized so each person only sees the data they are entitled to.

RealCases.Title: Typical scenarios
RealCases.Intro: Representative projects, described without a named client or quantified result.

Cases.Title: Automatic task assignment between SharePoint and Teams
Cases.Summary: Illustrative scenario. A system combining Teams, Planner and Power Automate suggests who should take a task, based on skills, current workload and working languages. The manager keeps the final decision.

Cases.Title: Multi-level expense approval workflow
Cases.Summary: Illustrative scenario. A mobile Power Apps application pre-fills the expense report from a photo of the receipt, checks compliance with the internal policy and routes the request by amount and risk through an automated approval flow.

Cases.Title: Client onboarding portal in SharePoint
Cases.Summary: Illustrative scenario. Opening a client file is orchestrated with SharePoint, Forms, Teams and Power Automate: creation of a structured team space, secure collection of documents, compliance checks run in parallel and coordination between departments.

Cases.Title: Real-time project dashboard in Power BI
Cases.Summary: Illustrative scenario. Power BI dashboards fed from Project and Teams consolidate schedule, budget and resource load so that several projects can be followed at once and deviations spotted earlier.

Cases.Title: Contract management in SharePoint with SPFx
Cases.Summary: Illustrative scenario. An SPFx application manages a portfolio of contracts with automatic metadata and progressive alerts: critical dates are extracted by AI, termination windows are calculated, and deadlines are confirmed by a person.

Cases.Title: Approval workflow with Adaptive Cards in Teams
Cases.Summary: Illustrative scenario. Workflows with Teams adaptive cards determine the approval path according to the level of risk, handle deputies during absences and escalate the request when needed. Approvers can process requests from their smartphone.

UseCases.Title: Common use cases
UseCases.Text: Automation of approval processes, internal knowledge bases, customer portals in SharePoint, financial dashboards in Power BI, and much more. Each project starts with an analysis of your needs and aims for a solution that fits naturally into your daily routine.

Items.Desc: Eliminate manual tasks and reduce error risks through automation.

Items.Desc: Facilitate teamwork with modern and integrated tools.

TypicalSituations.Title: Typical situations
TypicalSituations.Disclaimer: Fictional, simplified examples of situations we can handle. They do not describe specific client projects or guaranteed results.

Cases.Situation: Expense and invoice approvals run over email and nobody knows where a file stands.
Cases.WhatWeDo: Power Automate approval flow with Teams cards, amount thresholds, an audit trail in SharePoint and a tracking board; documentation of the flow for your IT team.

Cases.Situation: Management figures are copied every month from Excel and the CRM into a slide deck.
Cases.WhatWeDo: Power BI data model connected to the existing sources, automatically refreshed dashboard, role-based access and support for getting started.

Cases.Situation: A SharePoint intranet exists, but contracts and their deadlines get lost in folders.
Cases.WhatWeDo: Structured library with metadata, deadline alerts, an SPFx web part for the overview and guided migration of the existing documents.
